name: Partial pooling
description: Two groups have the same raw mean. How much should each one move toward the population?

source.text:
def pooling(counts, observed):
    population = numpyro.sample("population", dist.Normal(0, 1))
    with numpyro.plate("groups", len(counts)):
        location = numpyro.sample("location", dist.Normal(population, 0.35))
        error = numpyro.deterministic("error", 1 / jnp.sqrt(counts))
        numpyro.sample("group_mean", dist.Normal(location, error), obs=observed)
